[e00408] time=9:55 am on 22 October, 2023 speaker=Melanie type=log source={"channel": "hook", "message_role": "user"}

[e00412] time=9:55 am on 22 October, 2023 speaker=Melanie type=log source={"channel": "hook", "message_role": "user"}

[e00413] time=9:55 am on 22 October, 2023 speaker=Caroline type=log source={"channel": "hook", "message_role": "user"}

[e00414] time=9:55 am on 22 October, 2023 speaker=Melanie type=log source={"channel": "hook", "message_role": "user"}

[e00415] time=9:55 am on 22 October, 2023 speaker=Caroline type=log source={"channel": "hook", "message_role": "user"}

[e00416] time=9:55 am on 22 October, 2023 speaker=Melanie type=log source={"channel": "hook", "message_role": "user"}

[e00417] time=9:55 am on 22 October, 2023 speaker=Caroline type=log source={"channel": "hook", "message_role": "user"}
Glad you agree, Caroline. Appreciate the support of those close to me. Their encouragement made me who I am.

[e00418] time=9:55 am on 22 October, 2023 speaker=Melanie type=log source={"channel": "hook", "message_role": "user"}
Glad you had support. Being yourself is great!
